column1: # What typing the word and a space commits, through the typing orchestrator, the engine and the
# JNI bridge, against the shipped packs. Read by PipelineTest.
# `committed` is "-" when the typed text is left untouched.
# `reason` is which claim won on the last word typed: a rewrite's kind (Shortcut, Contraction,
# Possessive, Capital), one of autocorrect's situations, or NotProse -- see WordCommit.
# --- a word still being typed is completed, not corrected -------------------------------------
# One edit plus one completed character; an edit that lands on a word is not completed further.
# Two edits only from eight letters (CORRECTION_DISTANCE_NORMAL).
# --- a finished word with a slip in it is corrected -------------------------------------------
# A mark before a word is a key of its own; the word after it is decided without it.
# By the apostrophe map, before autocorrect is asked.
# --- a name's possessive the corpus never wrote -----------------------------------------------
# --- a regular inflection of a word the dictionaries hold -------------------------------------
# A misspelt inflection is corrected when the answer has the same stem.
# A doubled final letter is corrected.
# --- a word the dictionaries spell is left alone ----------------------------------------------
# --- an address or a filename is not a sentence -----------------------------------------------
# A word a digit ends, or one that follows a digit, is not corrected.
# --- a two-letter word the pack holds is left alone -------------------------------------------
# --- a word the pack holds only as a name is capitalised --------------------------------------
# --- contractions the dictionaries already hold are left alone --------------------------------
